instruction: Candid cinematic medium shot of an outdoor balcony at sunset. The man with white hair and beard (R1) in a dark turtleneck stands on the left, looking aside. The woman with blonde-gray hair (R2) in a blue trench coat stands on the right, hugging him closely and resting her head on his chest. His arm wraps around her back in a warm embrace. Warm golden sunset light illuminates them from behind, casting a soft glow against the city background.
